expect_red: a click puts a surface in the set or takes it out; a hole of a pattern line comes out alone, and a suggestion taken is one line of its faces

mutations.contract: A click on a surface the set holds takes it out; any other puts it in.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff editing_a_feature_opens_its_form_where_the_tree_was (2026-11-23). Always adds: a second click on a shoulder would add it again rather than take it out.
mutations.find: if (!touched) out.push({ kind: AA.EDIT_LINE_KINDS[0], faces: ascending(faces || []) });

mutations.contract: A hole taken out of a pattern leaves the pattern one hole fewer.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff editing_a_feature_opens_its_form_where_the_tree_was (2026-11-23). Keeps the count: a pattern line would claim a hole the set no longer holds.
mutations.find: out.push({ kind: line.kind, faces: keep, holes: line.holes - 1 });
mutations.replace: out.push({ kind: line.kind, faces: keep, holes: line.holes });
